label: SW16 ashfoot_shelter_inside Medium cand|ship
brief: Fixed production-camera views of one Stormwood location (ashfoot shelter inside) through a storm's calm, building, break and fading phases, with the 1.80 m trainer as a ruler. Judge whether it reads as the key art's Stormwood: a storm-lit purple forest realm with readable landmarks, convincing ground and light and weather that belong to the world.
defects: Flat magenta slabs or rings on the ground
Placeholder or untextured materials (flat grey, checker or faceted blocks)
Floating bodies or props (a gap between an object and the ground under it)
Clipping (geometry passing through geometry, or the camera inside geometry)
F41 gap 1: a repeated ground carpet with weak soil, moss and rock transitions
F41 gap 3: rigid glass slabs or white strips and smooth cyan cones that do not sit in the terrain
the shelter interior reads as a bare plaster box with no Stormwood lining, hearth or lived-in dressing
the storm window reads as a glowing slab standing off the wall, and its light does not change with the storm phase
